Name: Female Clint
Author: toadparty
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/headers/50775_1786856631.jpg[/img][/center]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod replaces Clint with a female alter ego, Clem. This mod is meant to feel "basically vanilla," so it stays as close as possible to the original design and personality of the character, just... female! Some dialogue edits have been made to accommodate Clem's gender, but the mopey spirit of the character remains intact.[/color]

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Replaces all of Clint's portraits and overworld sprites with female versions.[/*]
[*]Replaces all dialogue spoken by or about Clint to reference her new name and gender.[/*]
[*]Both features above are independently toggleable on and off using GMCM or by editing the config.json file.[/*]
[*]Optional patch adds compatibility with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] mod, adding seasonal outfits for Clem.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder[color=#d4d4d8].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game with SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod uses Content Patcher to overwrite Clint's sprites and related dialogue, and therefore should be compatible with basically any other mod unless it touches the same sprites/lines. It is confirmed compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] as long as you download the optional patch. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, you can separately enable/disable the sprites and dialogue in case you want to use them alongside another portrait/dialogue mod.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Planned updates[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod is essentially complete, but I do plan to update it once 1.7 comes out to make it compatible with the new content. If you find any bugs or mistakes, please let me know![/color][/size]

[b][size=4]Permissions[/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I gladly support all forks of this mod or use of its assets for the purpose of translating it, expanding it, including it in a compilation, or updating/fixing it if I can't at some point in the future. All I request is that you credit me by linking back to this original mod page. :-)[/color][/size]
